plan: This is a first-price sealed-bid auction where the winner pays the second-highest bid. This is commonly known as a Vickrey auction or a second-price sealed-bid auction. In such auctions, the dominant strategy for a bidder is to bid their true value. Bidding below your value risks losing an item you would have profited from. Bidding above your value risks winning an item and paying more than it's worth to you. Therefore, I will bid my true value of $24.

My goal is to maximize long-term profit. Since the value is drawn independently each round, past rounds don't directly influence the current optimal bid. This is a second-price auction. The optimal strategy in a second-price auction is to bid your true value. This ensures that I win only when my value is higher than the second-highest bid, maximizing my profit.

This is a single-round game, so long-term profit maximization translates to maximizing profit in this round. Since I pay the second-highest bid if I win, my optimal strategy is to bid my true value. This ensures I only win when my value is greater than what I pay, maximizing my individual profit for this round.
